source_context: The configuration page allows you to customize the parameters used by the [`/link/token/create`](/docs/api/link/#linktokencreate) call used by **Launch Link** (including important parameters like `products`, which can impact the set of institutions available in Link), as well as the [`/sandbox/public_token/create`](/docs/api/sandbox/#sandboxpublic_tokencreate) overrides used by **Skip Link**. Changing configuration here does not affect your integration; it only changes the calls Sandbox Studio makes. For more details on the configuration options avilable here, see the documentation for [`/link/token/create`](/docs/api/link/#linktokencreate).
